name: auth-separation
description: Specification Driven Development example: separated AuthN, AuthZ and User Info services. This package validates the specifications and drives generation of the server stubs from them; the services themselves build with the .NET SDK.

scripts.generate:authn: dotnet tool restore && dotnet nswag run services/authn/nswag.json && node scripts/generate-stub-impl.mjs services/authn/src/AuthSeparation.AuthN/Generated/AuthNController.g.cs services/authn/src/AuthSeparation.AuthN/Generated/AuthNControllerImpl.g.cs
scripts.generate:authz: dotnet tool restore && dotnet nswag run services/authz/nswag.json && node scripts/generate-stub-impl.mjs services/authz/src/AuthSeparation.AuthZ/Generated/AuthZController.g.cs services/authz/src/AuthSeparation.AuthZ/Generated/AuthZControllerImpl.g.cs
scripts.generate:userinfo: dotnet tool restore && dotnet nswag run services/userinfo/nswag.json && node scripts/generate-stub-impl.mjs services/userinfo/src/AuthSeparation.UserInfo/Generated/UserInfoController.g.cs services/userinfo/src/AuthSeparation.UserInfo/Generated/UserInfoControllerImpl.g.cs
scripts.generate: npm run generate:authn && npm run generate:authz && npm run generate:userinfo
scripts.verify: npm run lint:openapi && npm run lint:asyncapi && npm run lint:gherkin && npm run lint:secrets && npm run lint:kanban && npm run lint:kanban-content
